==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Glow Girl attacked the village in her attempt to find me. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Glow Girl is a young woman in her twenties with a purple bob haircut with red highlights. She wears a plastic looking crop-top and matching shorts that both contain a sparkling glowing purple liquid, giving both a lava lamp like aesthetic. She also wears black lace-up boots with red laces.)
I calmed her down and explained to her that she's a fusion of two characters I created as a child. (The two characters that Glow Girl is a fusion of are Glow Boy and Dream Girl, which are two characters that I used to make comics about when I was a kid.)
Her unique fusion of powers is identical to Lucid Light, which is likely why she suddenly appeared in the village. (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
